messages:
Ivy: Quick sync — planning a short focused sweep to replace `client.invoke` examples and deprecated v1 curl endpoints. Target: small PRs, land by Fri.
Noah: I'll swap JS + TS snippets. Will open one PR per directory.
Rafael: I'll handle curl and Python examples, and add redirects for any renamed pages.
Ivy: Soft freeze: no new content after Thu 18:00 UTC. Emergency fixes ok. Tag PRs with `docs/deprecation-sweep`.
Noah: Example TS migration (compact):
```ts
// v1
await client.invoke({ model: 'r-assist', prompt })
// v2
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'r-assist-2024-02', input: prompt })
console.log(r.output[0].content.filter(c=>c.type==='output_text').map(c=>c.text).join('\n'))
```
Rafael: Curl replacement (old -> new):
OLD: `POST /v1/invoke` with `{"model":"r-chat","prompt":"hi"}`
NEW: `POST /v2/responses` with `{"model":"r-chat-2024-02","input":"hi"}`
I will convert blog embeds too.
Ivy: Add small helper in docs utils: `extractText(res)` and reference it in snippets to keep examples concise.
docs-bot: Template created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/9021 (auto-label `docs/deprecation-sweep`).
Support: Please ensure PRs have the 'no real PII' checkbox. We'll reject examples containing secrets.
Intl: Mark strings touched with `i18n:needs-review` so translators see them.
Noah: Opening PRs in batches of 4. Will mark `bounty-eligible` for quick fixes.
Rafael: Redirects snippet I'll add to `website/docs/redirects-map.json`: {"/docs/legacy/invoke":"/docs/reference/responses"}. I'll run the redirect validator.
Ivy: QA steps: build site + run `npm run smoke:snippets`. Report failures here.
docs-bot: PRs opened: 5. CI pending.
Noah: Merged 2 PRs, CI good. One snippet failed due to direct `.text` access; submitted fix.
Rafael: Blog embeds updated and redirect added. Validator passed.
Ivy: Final checklist before close: all PRs merged, smoke green, redirects deployed, deprecation note updated in /docs/news. Will post a short announcement once live.
Support: Noted — will monitor help queue for migration questions.
Ivy: Thanks team, small follow-ups after deploy. Close thread when announcement posted.
